configurations.name: frontend
configurations._comment: 5173 is not negotiable: it is the only origin registered with the Google OAuth client, and Sign in with Google compares the port. An assigned port serves the app fine and then fails sign-in with origin_mismatch. If 5173 is taken by a healthy Vite, use frontend-attach rather than starting a second one.

configurations.name: backend
configurations._comment: 8001 is not negotiable: frontend/src/data/api.ts falls back to http://<host>:8001 when VITE_API is unset, so an assigned port would be unreachable. If 8001 is already taken by a healthy backend, use backend-attach rather than freeing it.

configurations.name: apk-share
configurations._comment: The latest debug APK, for a phone on the same Wi-Fi: open http://<laptop's Wi-Fi address>:8090/app-debug.apk in the phone's browser. Serves only Gradle's debug output folder, so each build is the one served. Stop it once the phone has the app.

configurations.name: frontend-attach
configurations._comment: Attach to the user's own Vite on 5173 instead of starting a second server.

configurations.name: backend-attach
configurations._comment: Attach to a backend already running on 8001 instead of starting a second one.
